poker.title: Poker
poker.choose.matches: 1 — for matches: {0} each. Nothing to lose but your honour.
poker.choose.roubles: 2 — small stakes: {0} roubles to sit in, ante {1}, bets {2} and {3}.
poker.choose.cap: Nobody is let lose more than {0} roubles a night here.
poker.closed: The table gathers in the evening, after ten.
poker.cap: Enough for tonight: nobody loses more than {0} roubles an evening here. Matches are fine.
poker.no_money: It takes {0} roubles to sit in. You can play for matches.
poker.nobody: Nobody left to play: the table has broken up.
poker.help.1: Everybody antes and gets five cards. A round of betting: fold, check or call, bet or raise.
poker.help.2: Then everyone changes up to three cards, a second round (the bets are doubled) and the showdown.
poker.help.3: From the lowest: a pair, two pair, three of a kind, a straight (five in a row), a flush (five of a suit),
poker.help.4: a full house (three and a pair), four of a kind, a straight flush, a royal flush.
poker.help.5: Whoever cannot cover a bet goes all in and plays for his share of the pot only.
poker.help.6: Watch the people, not only your cards: everyone gives himself away in his own fashion.
poker.keys.draw: A / D — pick a card     W — mark it to change (up to three)     E — change
poker.keys.next: E — next hand     S / Esc — get up from the table
poker.keys.common: H — rules     Esc — get up from the table
poker.keys.over: E / Esc — get up from the table
poker.log.left: {0} is out of the game: nothing left to bet.
poker.log.goes: {0} gets up from the table: time to go.
poker.log.your_draw: The draw: mark the cards you throw away.
poker.sharp.suspect: Albert's draw has come out a full house again. How many times tonight…
poker.sharp.suspect2: If only one could watch his hands while he deals.
poker.sharp.caught: Got him! Albert is nicking the corner of an ace with his nail.
poker.sharp.caught2: The "engineer from Riga" turns pale and sidles out of the saloon. The hand is void, the antes go back.
poker.sharp.missed: You keep your eyes on Albert's hands. A clean deal — this time.
poker.sharp.clean: You watch the hands. {0}: a clean deal.
poker.sharp.not_now: Nothing to see now: the moment to watch is while the cards are dealt.
poker.end.left: You get up from the table.
poker.end.empty: Nobody left to play: everyone has gone.
poker.end.hands: "That will do for tonight" — the deck goes back in its box. Good night.
poker.end.clock: Past one in the morning. The bosun puts out the lamp over the table: lights out.
poker.end.matches: The matches go back in the box: you had {0}, you leave with {1}.
dev.action.poker.open: Poker: sit at the table (everyone in)
poker.style.ship_albert: The "engineer from Riga". Plays few hands, and big. His face tells you next to nothing.
poker.style.ship_givi: The barman, off his shift. Plays almost any hand. The worse the cards, the longer the story.
poker.style.ship_vera: A geography teacher. Careful, and misses nothing.
poker.style.ship_taras: The bosun. Bold. Bluffs a lot and cannot lie to save his life.
poker.style.ship_blum: The pianist. Plays by ear: now a stroke of genius, now a wrong note.
poker.style.ship_lev: The radio operator. Works the odds out to the third decimal.
poker.tell.ship_albert.strong.0: Albert lays his cards face down and does not look at them again.
poker.tell.ship_albert.strong.1: Albert straightens a cuff and looks at the pot, not at you.
poker.tell.ship_albert.strong.2: Albert puts his bet down in a neat stack, in no hurry.
poker.tell.ship_albert.strong.3: Albert smiles faintly and asks for a mineral water.
poker.tell.ship_albert.strong.4: Albert taps a fingernail on the back of his top card.
poker.tell.ship_albert.strong.5: Albert leans back in his chair: "Well, young man?"
poker.tell.ship_albert.weak.0: Albert studies his cards for a long time, like a blueprint.
poker.tell.ship_albert.weak.1: Albert sighs: "The cards don't love an engineer."
poker.tell.ship_albert.weak.2: Albert turns the ring on his finger and says nothing.
poker.tell.ship_albert.weak.4: Albert gazes absently at the dark porthole.
poker.tell.ship_albert.weak.5: Albert rubs the bridge of his nose: "They don't deal like this in Riga."
poker.tell.ship_albert.bluff.0: Albert bets fast, almost carelessly, and lights up at once.
poker.tell.ship_albert.bluff.1: Albert looks you straight in the eye and does not blink.
poker.tell.ship_albert.bluff.2: Albert is suddenly very polite: "Your call, if you please."
poker.tell.ship_albert.bluff.3: Albert pushes his bet to the middle of the table with one finger.
poker.tell.ship_albert.bluff.4: Albert whistles something from an operetta.
poker.tell.ship_albert.bluff.5: Albert smiles with his lips only.
poker.tell.ship_givi.strong.0: Givi stops in mid-sentence and looks at his cards.
poker.tell.ship_givi.strong.1: Givi pulls his chair closer to the table.
poker.tell.ship_givi.strong.2: Givi stops joking and squares his cards carefully.
poker.tell.ship_givi.strong.4: Givi's moustache twitches: he is trying very hard not to smile.
poker.tell.ship_givi.strong.5: Givi covers his cards with his palm, like a saucer of tips.
poker.tell.ship_givi.weak.0: Givi is telling a story about Batumi and not looking at his cards.
poker.tell.ship_givi.weak.1: Givi recalls how his uncle lost a donkey at backgammon.
poker.tell.ship_givi.weak.2: Givi explains what real Turkish coffee ought to be.
poker.tell.ship_givi.weak.3: Givi asks whether everyone has tried his tarragon lemonade.
poker.tell.ship_givi.weak.4: Givi starts on the storm off Poti — his third story tonight.
poker.tell.ship_givi.weak.5: Givi laughs at his own joke louder than anyone.
poker.tell.ship_givi.bluff.0: Givi proposes a toast to the brave and bets before he has finished it.
poker.tell.ship_givi.bluff.1: Givi tells a joke, watching sideways who looks how.
poker.tell.ship_givi.bluff.2: Givi bets and at once asks if anyone would like some tea.
poker.tell.ship_givi.bluff.3: Givi swears on his mother that his hand is this good!
poker.tell.ship_givi.bluff.4: Givi talks too fast and forgets where he began.
poker.tell.ship_givi.bluff.5: Givi slaps the table: "Eh, here goes nothing!"
poker.tell.ship_vera.strong.0: Vera Ignatyevna takes off her glasses and lays them by her cards.
poker.tell.ship_vera.strong.1: Vera Ignatyevna straightens her back, as at the blackboard.
poker.tell.ship_vera.strong.2: Vera Ignatyevna looks at you over her glasses: "Well then."
poker.tell.ship_vera.strong.3: Vera Ignatyevna bets at once, without counting.
poker.tell.ship_vera.strong.4: Vera Ignatyevna fans her cards as evenly as outline maps.
poker.tell.ship_vera.strong.5: Vera Ignatyevna gives herself the smallest of nods.
poker.tell.ship_vera.weak.0: Vera Ignatyevna purses her lips and puts her cards in order.
poker.tell.ship_vera.weak.1: Vera Ignatyevna sighs: "A bottom mark for a deal like this."
poker.tell.ship_vera.weak.2: Vera Ignatyevna spends a long time wiping her glasses on her shawl.
poker.tell.ship_vera.weak.3: Vera Ignatyevna counts the pot in a whisper.
poker.tell.ship_vera.weak.4: Vera Ignatyevna adjusts her shawl and looks at the clock.
poker.tell.ship_vera.weak.5: Vera Ignatyevna says "we shall see, we shall see" with no conviction at all.
poker.tell.ship_vera.bluff.0: Vera Ignatyevna bets in a stern voice, as if announcing a test.
poker.tell.ship_vera.bluff.1: Vera Ignatyevna suddenly asks what the capital of Paraguay is.
poker.tell.ship_vera.bluff.2: Vera Ignatyevna lines her bet up a little too carefully.
poker.tell.ship_vera.bluff.3: Vera Ignatyevna is looking not at you but into a corner of the saloon.
poker.tell.ship_vera.bluff.4: Vera Ignatyevna fidgets with the arm of her glasses.
poker.tell.ship_taras.strong.0: Taras booms: "Hold on to the rails, all hands!"
poker.tell.ship_taras.strong.1: Taras rubs his hands, each as big as a shovel.
poker.tell.ship_taras.strong.2: Taras grunts with pleasure and twirls his moustache.
poker.tell.ship_taras.strong.3: Taras bets and leans back calmly: the chair creaks.
poker.tell.ship_taras.strong.4: Taras gives you a cheerful wink.
poker.tell.ship_taras.strong.5: Taras hums an old sailors' song under his breath.
poker.tell.ship_taras.weak.0: Taras scratches the back of his head and breathes heavily.
poker.tell.ship_taras.weak.1: Taras grumbles: "That's not a hand, that's a deck mop."
poker.tell.ship_taras.weak.2: Taras glumly ties a knot in a scrap of line.
poker.tell.ship_taras.weak.3: Taras looks at his cards again, in case they have changed.
poker.tell.ship_taras.weak.4: Taras pushes his cards away and looks up at the deckhead.
poker.tell.ship_taras.weak.5: Taras mutters: "All right, let's see what's what."
poker.tell.ship_taras.bluff.0: Taras bets so loudly that the table jumps.
poker.tell.ship_taras.bluff.2: Taras says "I've got a whopper here!" and does not know what to do with his hands.
poker.tell.ship_taras.bluff.3: Taras looks away and whistles out of tune.
poker.tell.ship_taras.bluff.4: Taras coughs into his fist and hurries you: "Go on, go on."
poker.tell.ship_taras.bluff.5: Taras grips his cards so hard that they bend.
poker.tell.ship_blum.strong.0: Blum drums a major chord on the table with his fingers.
poker.tell.ship_blum.strong.1: Blum hums something quick, in foxtrot time.
poker.tell.ship_blum.strong.2: Blum smiles at his cards as at old friends.
poker.tell.ship_blum.strong.3: Blum bets without looking: "Let it be forte."
poker.tell.ship_blum.strong.5: Blum says to nobody in particular: "A fanfare, maestro!"
poker.tell.ship_blum.weak.0: Blum's fingers play something in a minor key on the edge of the table.
poker.tell.ship_blum.weak.1: Blum looks at his cards like a score with five flats.
poker.tell.ship_blum.weak.2: Blum sighs: "The deck is out of tune tonight."
poker.tell.ship_blum.weak.3: Blum listens absently to the engine humming below the deck.
poker.tell.ship_blum.weak.4: Blum arranges his cards now this way, now that.
poker.tell.ship_blum.weak.5: Blum mutters: "A rest… A rest is music too."
poker.tell.ship_blum.bluff.0: Blum bets with a sweep of the arm, as if striking the last chord.
poker.tell.ship_blum.bluff.1: Blum starts humming and loses the tune.
poker.tell.ship_blum.bluff.2: Blum announces "Improvisation!" and pushes his bet in.
poker.tell.ship_blum.bluff.3: Blum looks at the ceiling and counts bars.
poker.tell.ship_blum.bluff.4: Blum takes far too long over his bow tie.
poker.tell.ship_blum.bluff.5: Blum says "Let's have a crescendo" and looks nobody in the eye.
poker.tell.ship_lev.strong.0: Lev Markovich bets at once: he has clearly done the sums.
poker.tell.ship_lev.strong.1: Lev Markovich taps with a finger: dot, dash, dot.
poker.tell.ship_lev.strong.3: Lev Markovich puts his pencil away in his breast pocket.
poker.tell.ship_lev.strong.4: Lev Markovich squares his cards and sets a matchbox on top.
poker.tell.ship_lev.strong.5: Lev Markovich looks at the pot and gives a satisfied grunt.
poker.tell.ship_lev.weak.0: Lev Markovich works something out in the margin of a newspaper.
poker.tell.ship_lev.weak.1: Lev Markovich mutters: "One in five… no, worse."
poker.tell.ship_lev.weak.2: Lev Markovich takes off his glasses and rubs his eyes.
poker.tell.ship_lev.weak.3: Lev Markovich taps out: three dots, three dashes, three dots.
poker.tell.ship_lev.weak.4: Lev Markovich shakes his head: "Static on the air."
poker.tell.ship_lev.weak.5: Lev Markovich looks at the pot, then at his cards, then at the pot again.
poker.tell.ship_lev.bluff.0: Lev Markovich bets and at once explains why theory says he is right.
poker.tell.ship_lev.bluff.1: Lev Markovich taps something out with a finger — and loses his place.
poker.tell.ship_lev.bluff.2: Lev Markovich says: "By the theory of probability it is time you folded."
poker.tell.ship_lev.bluff.3: Lev Markovich studies the backs of his cards far too closely.
poker.tell.ship_lev.bluff.4: Lev Markovich adjusts his glasses twice running.
poker.tell.ship_lev.bluff.5: Lev Markovich gives a dry cough and bets without looking up.
poker.talk.ship_albert.0: "In Riga, you know, they play more quietly."
poker.talk.ship_albert.1: "I am an engineer, strictly speaking. Cards are just a rest for the mind."
poker.talk.ship_albert.2: "The young man will go far. If he stops in time."
poker.talk.ship_albert.3: "The deck is rather worn. One might change it… But I don't insist."
poker.talk.ship_albert.6: "A lovely evening. A calm sea, a trusting public."
poker.talk.ship_albert.7: "I dislike playing for matches. But for the company's sake — very well."
poker.talk.ship_givi.0: "Whoever loses gets a cocktail on the house tomorrow. A milk one!"
poker.talk.ship_givi.1: "A barber in Batumi used to deal like that. He came to a bad end."
poker.talk.ship_givi.2: "Listen, my dear, don't stare at the cards like that — you'll burn a hole."
poker.talk.ship_givi.3: "All day I pour for people, and in the evening people clean me out."
poker.talk.ship_givi.4: "Eh, a hand like this is good for drinking tea and nothing else."
poker.talk.ship_givi.5: "What I want now is a khachapuri, not these twos of yours."
poker.talk.ship_givi.6: "The sea loves the brave. Who the cards love, I don't know."
poker.talk.ship_givi.7: "Hush, hush, they're dealing! Givi is silent. Givi is already silent."
poker.talk.ship_vera.0: "Deal more carefully, you are not at the market."
poker.talk.ship_vera.1: "Forty years in a school. I can see who is copying and who is bluffing."
poker.talk.ship_vera.2: "Bird Island tomorrow. Don't sit up too late."
poker.talk.ship_vera.3: "Don't slouch at the table. And don't show your cards to your neighbour."
poker.talk.ship_vera.4: "Poker is geography too: you must know where you stand."
poker.talk.ship_vera.6: "In my day children were asleep at this hour. Still, it is the holidays."
poker.talk.ship_taras.0: "Ha, wait till I bet — you'll know all about it!"
poker.talk.ship_taras.1: "In Murmansk we played for tinned stew. Now those were stakes!"
poker.talk.ship_taras.2: "Deal lively there, the watch won't wait!"
poker.talk.ship_taras.3: "Steady, lad. Cards are like a wave: now under you, now over you."
poker.talk.ship_taras.4: "Who shuffles like that? Give it here, it's not like tying knots."
poker.talk.ship_taras.5: "Not a word to the captain that I sit here till one."
poker.talk.ship_taras.6: "After lights out I want it quiet here. Well, nearly quiet."
poker.talk.ship_blum.0: "I've been playing all evening: first the piano, now on my nerves."
poker.talk.ship_blum.1: "Cards are like jazz: you know the rules and play by ear all the same."
poker.talk.ship_blum.3: "Young man, were you at the concert? Otar was on form tonight."
poker.talk.ship_blum.4: "In Odessa I lost my tailcoat in one evening. I played in a jumper after that."
poker.talk.ship_blum.5: "I would call that hand the Empty Pocket Blues."
poker.talk.ship_blum.6: "Deal in waltz time: one, two, three."
poker.talk.ship_blum.7: "Applause for the winner. Thin, but sincere."
poker.talk.ship_lev.0: "A royal flush comes once in 650,000 deals. I have waited forty years."
poker.talk.ship_lev.1: "A pair comes nearly every other deal. Don't be too glad of one."
poker.talk.ship_lev.2: "Cards are statistics. People are the static."
poker.talk.ship_lev.3: "All quiet in the radio room, the air is clear. One more hand, then."
poker.talk.ship_lev.4: "I keep notes. By the end of the voyage I'll say which of you bluffs most."
poker.talk.ship_lev.6: "Courage is a constant. Only the cards vary."
poker.talk.ship_lev.7: "He who wins the first hand seldom wins the evening. An observation."
